tasks.description: shipping_cost is missing the heavy-order surcharge for orders over 10 kg. Fix it so a 12 kg order with no discount costs 31.00 to ship.
grand_total is wrong: it adds up subtotals only. It should sum each order's total after discount and shipping, and the reconciliation test should pass.
format_summary should list orders from highest total to lowest, one per line.

discounted_total in pricing.py accepts discounts over 100 percent, which produces negative prices. Make it raise ValueError for any discount_pct outside 0 to 100. Before editing, read report.py to see how it calls discounted_total. After editing pricing.py, read report.py again and confirm the call still works with valid discounts.
